features.title: Stateful Packet Inspection
features.desc: Track sessions of network connections with dynamic packet filtering for fine-grained security policies.

features.title: IP/DNS-based Filtering
features.desc: Block web traffic from entire countries to prevent cyber criminals from attacking your business.

features.title: Anti-Spoofing
features.desc: Detect packets with false addresses to increase security and prevent identity spoofing attacks.

features.title: Captive Portal
features.desc: Display web pages to newly connected users before granting broader access to network resources.

features.title: Time-based Rules
features.desc: Activate firewall rules during specified days and time ranges for scheduled security policies.

features.title: IDS/IPS Protection
features.desc: Analyze network traffic for attack signatures and prevent malicious packets from being delivered.

features.title: IPsec
features.desc: Set up encrypted connections between devices to keep data sent over public networks secure.

features.title: OpenVPN
features.desc: Implement secure point-to-point or site-to-site connections in routed or bridged configurations.

features.title: Site-to-site & Remote Access
features.desc: Support for both site-to-site and remote-access VPN capabilities via IPsec or OpenVPN.

features.title: SSL Encryption
features.desc: Ensure privacy, authentication, and data integrity in Internet communications with SSL.

features.title: Multi-OS Client Support
features.desc: VPN clients for multiple operating systems including mobile devices, Windows, Mac, and Linux.

features.title: Split Tunneling
features.desc: Access dissimilar security domains at the same time, using the same or different network connections.

features.title: NAT Mapping
features.desc: Map IP address spaces by modifying network address information in the IP header of packets.

features.title: Policy-based Routing
features.desc: Forward and route data packets based on specified policies or filters using custom parameters.

features.title: Static Routing
features.desc: Configure manually-defined routing entries rather than information from dynamic routing traffic.

features.title: Multiple IP Addresses
features.desc: Support for multiple IP addresses per network interface for flexible network configurations.

features.title: DHCP Server
features.desc: Automatically provide and assign IP addresses, default gateways and other network parameters.

features.title: DNS Forwarding
features.desc: Determine how sets of DNS queries are handled by a designated server for efficient name resolution.

features.title: Customizable Dashboard
features.desc: View network information at a glance with configurable widgets for system monitoring.

features.title: Real-time Traffic Graphs
features.desc: Monitor interface traffic as it happens with detailed real-time graphical displays.

features.title: Comprehensive Logging
features.desc: Store logs locally either in memory or written to disk for troubleshooting and monitoring.

features.title: Multi-WAN Support
features.desc: Utilize multiple Internet connections for more reliable connectivity and greater throughput.

features.title: Connection Failover
features.desc: Automatic failover for clients if the first server cannot be reached, maintaining connectivity.

features.title: Bandwidth Management
features.desc: Throttle, reserve, or restrict bandwidth based on traffic priority and user quotas.
